item.name: 03 - F02 F06 Catalog
item.description: Gin calls the separately running gRPC catalog; these are HTTP requests exercising that boundary indirectly.

item.name: List catalog and select real manga IDs

exec: const save = (key, value) => { pm.collectionVariables.set(key, value); pm.environment.set(key, value); };

pm.test("Catalog response", () => { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.manga).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(d.manga.length); });pm.test("Selected title found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().manga.some(m=>m.id===pm.variables.get("mangaId"))).to.eql(true));

pm.test("Catalog response", () => { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.manga).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(d.manga.length); });pm.test("Selected author found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().manga.some(m=>m.id===pm.variables.get("mangaId"))).to.eql(true));

pm.test("Catalog response", () => { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.manga).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(d.manga.length); });pm.test("Genre filter applied", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().count).to.be.above(0); pm.response.json().manga.forEach(m=>pm.expect(m.genres.join(",").toLowerCase()).to.include(String(pm.variables.get("genre")).toLowerCase())); });

pm.test("All required detail fields", () => { const d=pm.response.json(); ["id","title","author","genres","status","total_chapters","description"].forEach(k=>pm.expect(d).to.have.property(k)); pm.expect(d.id).to.eql(pm.variables.get("mangaId")); });
